notes: Walked at the counter with Priya and Marcus during the 7:00-10:00 peak on July 8. Boundaries match the charter scope: register order through handoff, espresso drinks only.

process_steps.description: Take order and payment at the register
Mark the cup and place it in the drink queue
Prepare the drink at the espresso station
Call the customer's name at the pickup counter
Hand the drink to the customer

scope_start: Customer places order at the register
scope_end: Drink handed to the customer at the pickup counter
